name: Orderfacts Sales segment selects issotrx orders only, tenant-scoped
note: Covers a surface no other case touches: SEGMENTS. The segment is written as {CUBE}.issotrx = 'true', comparing against the STRING the cube SQL produces via CASE WHEN issotrx='Y' THEN 'true'. That coupling is invisible from the dimension: Cube's type: boolean converts 'Y'/'N' by itself, so the CASE looks removable, and removing it leaves the column holding 'Y'/'N' while the segment still tests for 'true' - matching zero rows, silently, with every measure case still green. This case exists so that refactor cannot land unnoticed.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id WHERE o.ad_client_id=1000026 AND o.processed='Y' AND o.isproposal='N' AND o.issotrx='Y' AND o.dateordered >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.dateordered < DATE '2026-09-01'
